cards.title: Diversify Beyond Tech Leadership
cards.insight: Market leadership is shifting away from technology as chip stocks plummet and sector concentration reverses. Investors holding concentrated tech positions face heightened volatility and should rebalance into underweighted sectors.
cards.takeaway: Review your portfolio allocation and trim overweight tech positions; move proceeds into defensive or overlooked sectors with lower valuations.

cards.title: Social Security Crisis Demands Action
cards.insight: With Social Security funds running dry, younger workers cannot rely on current benefit levels in retirement. The urgency for personal retirement planning has never been higher as government programs face structural funding gaps.
cards.takeaway: Maximize 401(k) and IRA contributions now; model retirement scenarios assuming reduced Social Security benefits relative to current projections.

cards.title: H-1B Work Visa Uncertainty Affects Career Planning
cards.insight: Tighter H-1B restrictions and green-card suspensions signal a shifting immigration landscape. For skilled workers or those in visa-dependent industries, work authorization stability is now a critical employment variable.
cards.takeaway: If visa-dependent, prioritize pathways to permanent residency; document skills in recession-resistant fields; consider geographic diversification of career options.

cards.title: Inflation-Driven Market Rotation Creates Opportunities
cards.insight: As central banks navigate inflation concerns, different asset classes respond asymmetrically—IT stocks rise while broader market indices slip. Tactical rebalancing during sector rotation can enhance risk-adjusted returns.
cards.takeaway: Use market weakness to rebalance; rotate a portion of bond allocations into inflation-hedging assets like dividend-paying stocks or commodities.
